title: Add Hermes runtime integration package

context.summary: Ship a runnable Hermes host integration package and conformance harness.
context.background: Mindory must provide a real integration surface even when the external Hermes SDK is not vendored.

in: Package documented Hermes hook registration helpers.
Provide a runnable example host that exercises lifecycle hooks, attachment upload and context recall.
Add conformance tests for identity mapping, prompt context, saved turns and later-session recall.
Update Hermes docs to describe the supported integration package.
Remove TASK-111-owned public-readiness debt from the gate.
out: Vendoring closed or unavailable external Hermes SDK code.

acceptance_criteria: A local Hermes-like host can import the package and register Mindory lifecycle hooks.
The example host uploads attachments and saves user/assistant turns through the API.
Later sessions recall source-backed context through the integration.
Docs no longer position the integration as fake-compatible only.

manual_checks: Confirm the integration package does not bypass the HTTP API.

risks: The package must remain stable even if external Hermes runtime naming changes.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
